fields.name: departmentFilter
fields.description:
Department codes (NeoIPC site codes) whose records are validated; empty =
every department the session can see.

fields.name: rules
fields.description: Ids of the validation rules to apply; empty = every rule.

fields.name: includeTestData
fields.description: Include the departments flagged as test units.

fields.name: applyValidationExceptions
fields.description:
Apply the validation-exception list; false renders without it, and the
report's header says so. Administrators only: the reporting service
refuses false from other callers.

fields.name: includeUnusedValidationExceptions
fields.description:
Add an appendix listing the exception records of the departments in
scope that match no record, or match one but exempt nothing.
Administrators only: the reporting service refuses true from other
callers.
